title: ISAAC-Eval: Reproducibility Package for "Decoupling Reasoning from Facts in a Multi-Agent Question-Answering Service for Research Data and Literature: A Case Study"
description: Reproducibility package for the paper (IEEE Access, under review). It contains the query sets (including the 40 adversarial queries), the deterministic gold functions, the execution harness, the common final-answer scorer (src/isaac_eval/uniform_score.py), the end-to-end hybrid runner, the run logs for the experiments in Section VII, and the scripts used for the independent human checks. Running `python -m isaac_eval.uniform_score` from the repository root reproduces the answer-accuracy figures reported in the paper. The user-interface code of the reference implementation is not included.
